description: Internal R&D: research agent orgs, workflow frameworks and control-room/village UIs (Sonnet, web) → local synthesis into improvements → Opus ranks → owner picks.

stages.task:
INTERNAL research for our own studio (not an app idea scan). Topic: {{topic}}.
First read CLAUDE.md, docs/plans/2026-11-internal-initiatives.md, docs/adr/0001-model-placement-standard.md and tools/engine/engine.js so you know what we already have.
Research with fetched sources (cite every claim with a link): (1) multi-agent frameworks and their role/org designs (e.g. CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph, MetaGPT, ChatDev, OpenHands) — what roles, handoffs, memory and review loops they use; (2) standard team workflow frameworks we could adopt per role (Scrum/Kanban, RACI, definition-of-ready/done, DORA metrics, incident/postmortem practice, design critique rituals, editorial calendars for creative); (3) agent observability/control UIs (LangSmith, AgentOps, Langfuse, Helicone and similar) and 'agent village'/simulation visualisations (e.g. generative-agents town, AI village style views) — which features matter.
Write docs/research/internal/{{date}}/findings.md: per area, 4-8 findings each with source link, what it is, and 'relevance to us' in one line.

Turn docs/research/internal/{{date}}/findings.md into concrete improvements for OUR studio. Write docs/research/internal/{{date}}/recommendations.md with 10-15 items. Each: title, department (eng | creative | rd | process), what to change (specific files/features), why (cite the finding), impact 1-5, effort S/M/L, and whether a local model can do it. Group as: Control Room UI, Village view, Workflows & roles, Engine, Creative pipeline.

Review docs/research/internal/{{date}}/recommendations.md against findings.md: drop weak or unsupported items, merge duplicates, fix impact/effort, and rank by impact/effort. Write docs/research/internal/{{date}}/proposal.md: a ranked table (rank, item, dept, impact, effort, local-ok), short rationale per top item, and an 'Owner decision' block with one checkbox line per item (Approve / Park / Reject). Approved items become lines in docs/internal/eng-backlog.md or docs/internal/creative-backlog.md after the owner decides — do not add them yourself.

stages.title: Internal improvements proposal {{date}}: approve what to build
